description: This file defines the SaveJobCategoryController class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically handling the pre-render logic for the job category save/edit interface. It toggles between edit and save components based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveJobCategoryController
classes.description: Controller managing the rendering logic for saving or editing a job category, extending the AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component based on whether a job category ID is present in the request, setting up either an edit or save component.
